tasks.title: Update Overview flaggedFarms to respect manual toggle
tasks.description: Modify Overview.tsx flaggedFarms filter so manual farms are not flagged for being offline, but are still flagged for storage near-full.
tasks.details: Edit `dashboard/client/src/pages/Overview.tsx` line 21-23. tasks.title: Diagnose and fix logout button not working

tasks.details: 1. Reproduce in browser: open devtools Network tab, click 'Cerrar sesión' in Sidebar.tsx (line 45). 2. Verify POST /api/logout fires and returns 200. 3. Check if the session cookie is cleared in Application > Cookies. 4. Confirm the ['me'] query is invalidated and refetches (check useLogout mutation in hooks, should call queryClient.invalidateQueries(['me'])). 5. If the cookie doesn't clear: check server-side /api/logout route in routes/auth.ts (should call reply.clearCookie). If the query doesn't refetch: check the onSuccess callback in the useLogout mutation. Apply the fix to the specific failure point: handler, server route, or invalidation logic.

tasks.title: Make import-minecoop.ts idempotent for jugadores import
tasks.description: Update importJugadores to skip duplicate inserts, making it safe to re-run the import script.
tasks.details: Edit `dashboard/server/src/scripts/import-minecoop.ts` line 15-21. Change the INSERT statement from `INSERT INTO players (minecraft_name, actividad) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(minecraft_name) DO UPDATE SET actividad = excluded.actividad` to `INSERT INTO players (minecraft_name, actividad) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(minecraft_name) DO NOTHING`. This prevents updating existing actividad on re-run; only new players are inserted. Alternatively, check for existence before insert: `const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM players WHERE minecraft_name = ?').get(j.username); if (!existing) insert.run(...);`. The DO NOTHING approach is simpler and matches the proyectos import pattern.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `npm run import-minecoop` twice in sequence. After the first run, count players (`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players`). After the second run, verify the count is unchanged and no errors are logged. Manually inspect a few player rows to confirm actividad values were not overwritten.

tasks.title: Make import-minecoop.ts idempotent for tareas import
tasks.description: Update importTareas to skip duplicate task inserts, making it safe to re-run the import script.
tasks.details: Edit `dashboard/server/src/scripts/import-minecoop.ts` line 109-146. Before inserting each task, check if a task with the same title already exists for the same project_id or farm_id: `const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE title = ? AND (project_id IS ? OR farm_id IS ?)').get(tarea.title, projectId, farmId); if (existing) continue;`. If found, skip the task and its subtasks/assignees. Alternatively, enforce uniqueness via a unique constraint on (title, project_id, farm_id) in schema.sql and handle ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, but the manual check is safer given existing data.
tasks.testStrategy: Seed a few tasks via import, then run `npm run import-minecoop` again. Verify task count (`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks`) is unchanged on the second run. Confirm no duplicate tasks with the same title+project_id appear in the tasks table. Verify subtasks and assignees for existing tasks are not duplicated.

tasks.title: Fix path traversal vulnerability in buildSchematic.js
tasks.description: Sanitize sourcePath input to prevent directory traversal attacks in buildSchematic.js compile function.
tasks.details: Edit `mineflayer/mineflayer-agent/src/tools/buildSchematic.js` line 16. Before calling loadLitematic or loadSchem, validate that sourcePath does not contain `..` or absolute path indicators. Use Node's path.resolve and path.relative to ensure the resolved path is within an allowed directory (e.g., a schematics/ folder). Example: `const allowedDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../schematics'); const resolved = path.resolve(allowedDir, sourcePath); if (!resolved.startsWith(allowedDir)) throw new Error('Invalid sourcePath');`. Apply the same to schemLoader.js and litematicLoader.js if they accept user-controlled paths.
tasks.testStrategy: Write a test in `test/tools/buildSchematic.test.js`: call compile with `sourcePath: '../../etc/passwd'` and assert it throws an error. Call with a valid path like `sourcePath: 'test.litematic'` and assert it succeeds. Verify resolved paths are logged or checked in debug mode.

tasks.title: Fix negative Litematica Size offset bug
tasks.description: Correct the Litematica loader to handle negative Size offsets correctly when computing block positions.
tasks.details: Edit `mineflayer/mineflayer-agent/src/schematics/litematicLoader.js`. Review the block position calculation logic (likely in a loop over regions and blocks). Litematica NBT structure stores Size (width, height, length) and an offset vector that can be negative. Ensure positions are computed as `worldPos = regionOffset + blockIndexPos + sizeOffset`, accounting for negative sizeOffset values. If the current code assumes non-negative offsets, update the arithmetic. Consult Litematica spec or existing parsers (e.g., litemapy) for reference.

Load it via loadLitematic and verify block positions match the expected coordinates. Compare output against a reference Litematica loader (e.g., Python litemapy) for the same file.
